## Goal

Produce a reproducible Docker deployment for staging and production on the Váš Hosting VPS, replacing Vercel and its crons.

## Context

See `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`. The candidate server is a small shared VPS (4 GB RAM, mostly in use) managed by VPS Centrum. Building on the server is not viable.

## Scope

- `output: 'standalone'` in `next.config.ts` (verify Payload compatibility).
- Multi-stage `Dockerfile` (node:24-slim, non-root user, healthcheck).
- `deploy/compose.yml` per environment, `127.0.0.1` port binding, memory limit, log rotation.
- GitHub Actions workflow: build and push to GHCR on push to `rebuild/v2` (staging tag) and on manual dispatch (production tag). Deploy step only after owner approval (environment protection).
- `deploy/deploy.sh` with deploy, migrate (explicit flag), rollback.
- Cron replacement commands and nightly `pg_dump` to R2 job definition.
- Remove `vercel.json` only once the replacement is documented and tested on staging.

## Out of scope

- Installing anything on the server (owner does it from the runbook, or approves each step).
- Coolify.
- Production migration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Image builds in CI and runs locally with `docker compose up` against a local Postgres, `/healthz` 200.
- [ ] Image size and idle memory usage reported.
- [ ] Runbook in `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` updated with exact commands.
- [ ] Codex deployment review passed.

## Required tests

- CI image build job green.
- Local container smoke: `/`, `/historie`, `/healthz`, `/admin` login page.

## Dependencies

- SC-003

## Priority

P0 · Phase A

## Agent

Claude Code (build) + Codex (review)
